say:1:1041580101:0.text: Lady Rayne! My name is Gwyneth. I'm a member of the Royal Guard.
say:1:1041580101:0.source_cn: 瑞恩小姐！我名为格温妮丝，是皇家守备军的一员。

say:2:1041580102:0.text: I've heard so much about your exploits against Bantus. I've been hoping for a chance to meet you in person!
say:2:1041580102:0.source_cn: 久闻你在对班题斯的战役中立下赫赫战功，我一直期盼着能与...

say:3:1041580103:0.text: Gwyneth... You're the Dragonslayer Knight, aren't you? Why did you want to see me?
say:3:1041580103:0.source_cn: 格温妮丝……你就是狩龙骑士？为什么想要见我？

say:4:1041580104:0.text: Wait... Is this because I haven't gone to Savannah to pay my respects to the royal family since I became head of the family?
say:4:1041580104:0.source_cn: 不，等等，难道是因为我接任家主后，从未去赛凡纳觐见过国...

say:5:1041580105:0.text: I'm so sorry! The fighting was so intense that I never had a chance to leave.
say:5:1041580105:0.source_cn: 万分抱歉！先前战事紧张，我一直未有机会抽身。

say:6:1041580106:0.text: You've misunderstood, Lady Rayne! As a fellow knight, I just wanted to express my sincere admiration.
say:6:1041580106:0.source_cn: 你误会了，瑞恩小姐。同为骑士，我只是想向你表示由衷的敬佩。

say:7:1041580107:0.text: Why? I haven't done anything special. I've only been doing my duty as head of the family.
say:7:1041580107:0.source_cn: 为何？我没做过什么特别的事，只是履行家主之责而已。

say:8:1041580108:0.text: And just call me Estrilda. We're about the same age, there's no need to be so formal.
say:8:1041580108:0.source_cn: 还有，叫我爱丝就好，我们年纪相仿，不必如此尊敬。

say:9:1041580109:0.text: Ahem, Miss Estrilda, your strength more than deserves such praise.
say:9:1041580109:0.source_cn: 爱丝特瑞达……咳，爱丝小姐，你的实力担得起这样的赞誉。

say:10:1041580110:0.text: My father used to say that it's thanks to House Rayne guarding Ashvale County that the imperial capital stays peaceful.
say:10:1041580110:0.source_cn: 父亲曾说过，正因有你们瑞恩家族驻守灰影郡，皇都才能一直...

say:11:1041580111:0.text: That legacy was built over generations by my ancestors. I know I'm still a long way behind my father, my uncle, and my cousin.
say:11:1041580111:0.source_cn: 那是我的祖先世代积累的基业。我很清楚，我与父亲、叔叔和...

say:12:1041580112:0.text: My only hope is that when the day comes for us to reunite, I can proudly tell them: I did not dishonor the Rayne name.
say:12:1041580112:0.source_cn: 我只希望在与他们重聚的那天，能够自豪地对他们说出：我不...

say:13:1041580113:0.text: Miss Estrilda... So you have doubts about yourself, too?
say:13:1041580113:0.source_cn: 爱丝小姐……原来，你也会有自我怀疑的时候吗？

say:14:1041580114:0.text: Of course I do. But I don't have much time to dwell on them. There's a war to fight, after all.
say:14:1041580114:0.source_cn: 当然会。但我没有多少时间去想那些，毕竟战事不等人。

say:15:1041580115:0.text: Yeah. Perhaps it's because I spent too much time overthinking things that I...
say:15:1041580115:0.source_cn: 嗯。或许就是因为我在此事上耗费了太多时间，才会……

say:16:1041580116:0.text: Um... Sorry, I seem to have taken the conversation in a pretty gloomy direction.
say:16:1041580116:0.source_cn: 呃……抱歉，格温妮丝小姐，是我把聊天气氛带偏了。

say:17:1041580117:1.text: Thank you for the reminder, though. Now that the front lines have settled, I really should start planning my trip to Savannah.
say:17:1041580117:1.source_cn: 多谢你的提醒。现在形势暂缓，我确实应该着手安排赛凡纳的...

say:18:1041580118:0.text: Let me be your guide! And if you can, please stay a few extra days.
say:18:1041580118:0.source_cn: 请让我来当你的向导吧，爱丝小姐。如果可以的话，请务必多...

say:19:1041580119:0.text: Why? Is His Majesty's schedule particularly packed?
say:19:1041580119:0.source_cn: 多停留几日？为什么?国王陛下的日程安排很紧凑吗？

say:20:1041580120:1.text: No, it's just that... there are a few tea shops in the city with wonderful afternoon tea. I'd love to take you!
say:20:1041580120:1.source_cn: 并非如此，只是……城内有几家餐厅的下午茶颇为出色，我很...

say:21:1041580121:0.text: And there's the Mithril Consortium stall! They always sell so many cute—I mean, exquisite dolls!
say:21:1041580121:0.source_cn: 还有秘银商会的摊位！那里经常会售卖许多可爱——我是说，...

say:22:1041580122:0.text: Dolls... Do they have any horses?

say:23:1041580123:0.text: We can hunt for them together! Though if it's a rare limited-edition one, it might take some effort...
say:23:1041580123:0.source_cn: 我们可以一起找找。如果是限量的隐藏款，可能获取会有些困难……

say:24:1041580124:0.text: Oh, and one more thing! I'd love for you to drop by the royal guard base and give us some pointers. When it comes to actual combat, we're nowhere near your level.
say:24:1041580124:0.source_cn: 还有一事——我想请你来守备军驻地看看，提供训练指导。毕...

say:25:1041580125:0.text: No need to be so formal, Gwyneth. I've actually been curious about how the royal guards train too.
say:25:1041580125:0.source_cn: 不用这么客气，格温妮丝小姐。其实我也一直想了解赛凡纳的...

say:26:1041580126:0.source_cn: 太好了，那我们就这样一言为定！
